launch_job: launch a training job with a shell command and extract its job ID from the output
build_image: build a container image by running a build command and return the resulting image name
collect_metrics_summary: collect and summarize TSV metrics files from a directory into a formatted markdown string
check_job_status: check the status of a training job by its ID and return a status string
cancel_job: cancel a running training job by its ID and return a boolean indicating success
